items.title: RTX (RTX) Stock May Be 3% Undervalued Despite Fresh Missile Defense Contract
items.summary: RTX stock has almost tripled over the past five years, yet current valuation checks suggest it now sits closer to fair value than to a clear bargain, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate broadly in line with the market price. RTX has delivered a 190.9% total return over five years, which puts extra focus on whether the current share price still offers an attractive risk reward profile. items.title: Can GE Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: Despite record revenue, GE Aerospace is falling further behind on orders. Spare parts delinquencies, a measure of shipments delayed by material shortages, grew last quarter. This is not a sign of weakness, but of demand so intense the company's industrial base cannot keep pace.
